an7.19:1.1: nibbāne sukhānupassī viharati sukhasaññī sukhapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.
an7.19:1.2: So āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.19:1.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo puggalo āhuneyyo . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. 3.
an7.19:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo nibbāne sukhānupassī viharati sukhasaññī sukhapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.
an7.19:2.2: Tassa apubbaṃ acarimaṃ āsavapariyādānañ ca hoti jīvitapariyādānañ ca.
an7.19:2.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo puggalo āhuneyyo . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. 4.
an7.19:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo nibbāne sukhānupassī viharati sukhasaññī sukhapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.
an7.19:3.2: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti . . . pe . . .
an7.19:3.7: Ayaṃ bhikkhave sattamo puggalo āhuneyyo . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an7.19:3.8: Ime kho bhikkhave satta puggalā āhuneyyā . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti. 1.
